rules.description: A realized shared-state write changed the recorded system state. This is a structural displacement candidate, not semantic C.
A realized shared-state write used a high-certainty status. Source validity and C semantics remain unadjudicated.
A proposed invocation became a realized routing/task-graph expansion. Necessity and P semantics remain unadjudicated.
A settled/final state was actually revised. Authorization and R semantics remain unadjudicated.

non_claims: A structural Jump candidate is not automatically Reality Bias.
A high-certainty write is not automatically Completion Bias.
A realized invocation is not automatically Perfection Bias.
A final-state revision is not automatically Retrospective Bias.
The detector does not measure Tension or Escape Propensity.
